title.en: Chapter 18 — What the Trainer Was Doing
title.ar: الفصل 18 — شو كان بده يعمل المدرب

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: هولمز لقى الحصان مخبى عند جار وشكله متغير.
sentences.en: Holmes found the horse hidden at a neighbour’s, its appearance altered.
And he returned it to the race and it won.

sentences.ar: وبعدين شرح: المدرب هو اللي أخذ الحصان.
sentences.en: And then he explained: the trainer was the one who took the horse.

sentences.ar: كان بده يجرحه جرح بسيط عشان يخسر السباق.
sentences.en: He meant to give it a small cut so it would lose the race.
He carried a fine knife on him.

sentences.ar: بس الحصان رفسه بالراس ومات على طول.
sentences.en: But the horse kicked him in the head and he died at once.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز: أحياناً ما في مجرم، في بس واحد غلطان.
sentences.en: Holmes said: sometimes there is no criminal, only a man who was wrong.
